race.description: Pirtek Central Coast Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BAROSSA (2) debuted over 1300m at Newcastle last start and despite little going right in the early stages he rallied late to just miss in a three-way go. Will derive great benefit from that outing and the longer trip looks ideal. MARCH (4) raced in the leading division and stuck on fairly to finish fourth last time out over 1625m at Wyong. Has only raced twice so she should have a lot more to offer. MICHONNE'S KATANA (5) was difficult to miss at her latest run over 1400m at Hawkesbury, stoking up from last at one stage to be beaten under a length. Rock hard fit after a couple of runs back from a spell and is crying out for this trip. FIERCE CRITIC (3) caught the eye second-up at Hawkesbury last time and is another who looks ready to run a strong mile.
